title: THE FREE WATCH
lesson: Free stuff always sends a bill
caption: Got a free gift from a stranger online? THE RULE BOOK Ep 23 (Day 3/80): The gold-ring guy sent Clyde a free gold watch. All he wants is one lil photo of the pages. Solo admits that's how the Collector got his pages: for a free pen. Score: SOLO 1, US 3. Clyde sent a fake page as bait. Now the guy says he's 10 minutes away. A) Hide the pages B) Wait for him. A or B? Comment CAST ME to join the story. #liferules #scamalert #stickman

lines: A STRANGER SENT ME A FREE WATCH!
THE GOLD RING GUY? WHAT'S THE CATCH?
ONE LIL PHOTO OF THE PAGES. NO CAP.
THAT'S HOW HE GOT MINE. FOR A PEN.
